_about: Every section the website can draw, in default page order, and the fields each one's content has. The backend checks every save against this; the admin builds its forms from it. Field kinds: text (one line), textarea, link (https://, #section, mailto:, tel:), select (one of options), strings (a list of lines), list (a list of items with their own fields). max is characters (text) or items (lists); count fixes a list's length where an animation needs exactly that many. Shared types are never drawn on their own: their content is used by several sections.
